name: ITMAX
recent: ITMAX 近期持续推进 AI 交通管理平台，计划到 2027 年将 AI 交通管理系统部署至 17,000 个摄像头。公司也因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股，同时雇员公积金局（EPF）和部分董事出现股权变动。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收和净利均实现环比和同比增长。
notable: 公司计划到 2027 年将 AI 交通管理系统部署至 17,000 个摄像头。
公司因员工认股权计划（ESOS）行使而多次发行新股。
最新季度（2026-06-30）营收和净利均实现环比和同比增长。
risks: 首席财务官 Shaun Tee Wen Han 于 2026 年 10 月 16 日出售 10,000 股。
独立非执行主席 Tan Sri Dato' Seri Dr. Ir. Ahmad Tajuddin bin Ali 于 2026 年 10 月 14 日出售 80,000 股。
ESOS 行使持续小幅稀释现有股东持股。
earnings: 2026-06-30 季度营收为 MYR 74.999 million，环比增长 13.9%，同比增长 28.3%；净利为 MYR 30.01 million，环比增长 20.0%，同比增长 30.1%；净利率为 40.0%，高于上一季度的 38.0%。

recent_en: ITMAX is advancing its AI traffic management platform, targeting deployment across 17,000 cameras by 2027. The company has also issued new shares multiple times under its ESOS, while EPF and certain directors recorded changes in their shareholdings. The latest quarter (2026-06-30) saw both revenue and net profit grow QoQ and YoY.
notable_en: The company plans to deploy its AI traffic management system across 17,000 cameras by 2027.
The company issued new shares multiple times due to exercises under its Employee Share Option Scheme (ESOS).
The latest quarter (2026-06-30) saw both revenue and net profit grow QoQ and YoY.
risks_en: Chief Financial Officer Shaun Tee Wen Han disposed of 10,000 shares on 16 October 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman Tan Sri Dato' Seri Dr. Ir. Ahmad Tajuddin bin Ali disposed of 80,000 shares on 14 October 2026.
ESOS exercises continue to slightly dilute existing shareholders' holdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 74.999 million, up 13.9% QoQ and 28.3% YoY; net profit was MYR 30.01 million, up 20.0% QoQ and 30.1% YoY; net margin was 40.0%, higher than 38.0% in the previous quarter.
